articles.title: Michelin Keys 2026 Recognises Three of Sands China's Esteemed Properties as Among the Best Globally
articles.rawDate: Sep.24 Michelin Keys 2026 Recognises Three of Sands China's Esteemed Properties as Among the Best Globally
articles.summary: (Macao, Sept. 24, 2026) – Sands China Ltd. has once again demonstrated its world-class hospitality expertise with three of its celebrated properties securing prestigious Michelin Keys in the 2026 selection. For the second consecutive year, The Londoner® Hotel, Four Seasons Hotel Macao, and The St. Regis Macao have all been awarded One Key.

articles.title: Celebrating Two Michelin Keys for Four Seasons Hotel Hong Kong
articles.summary: Four Seasons Hotel Hong Kong has been elevated from One Michelin Key to Two Michelin Keys in the Michelin Guide’s 2026 hotel selection, marking a significant milestone just one year after the Michelin Key distinction was first introduced in Hong Kong. The hotel is one of only four hotels in the city to receive Two Keys in the 2026 selection.

articles.title: Sands China Leads Macao Awardees with Most Restaurants Recognised on Trip.Gourmet's 2027 Fine Dining List
articles.rawDate: Sep.19 Sands China Leads Macao Awardees with Most Restaurants Recognised on Trip.Gourmet's 2027 Fine Dining List
articles.summary: (Macao, September 19, 2026) – Sands China Ltd. has reinforced its status as a premier gastronomic destination with six of its signature restaurants earning ratings on Trip.Gourmet’s 2027 Fine Dining List, giving it the honour of having the most awardees in Macao under one roof.

articles.title: Grand Lisboa Palace Becomes Greater China’s First Sustained Carbon-Neutral Integrated MICE Venue
articles.summary: (Macau, 17 September 2026) — SJM Resorts, S.A. today announced that Grand Lisboa Palace Resort Macau has become the first integrated MICE venue in Greater China to achieve sustained carbon neutrality through high-quality carbon credits. The company also launched Macau’s first standardised Zero-Carbon MICE Service.

articles.title: GEG Wins Four Accolades at the 2026 IAG Academy IR Awards; Including “Best Integrated Resort” for the Fourth Consecutive Year and “Best Individual CSR Initiative”
articles.summary: September 16, 2026 – Galaxy Entertainment Group (“GEG”) garnered four awards at the 2026 IAG Academy IR Awards held yesterday in Manila, Philippines, making it once again the most awarded integrated resort operator in Macau. Galaxy Macau was named “Best Integrated Resort” for the fourth consecutive year and “Best IR Gaming Floor,” Capella at Galaxy Macau was named “Best Hotel in an IR” for the second consecutive year, and the “GEG Sports for Good Community Program” received “Best Individual CSR Initiative.”

articles.title: The Parisian Macao Celebrates 10th Anniversary with Exclusive Moët & Chandon Dinners and Stunning Drone Shows
articles.rawDate: Sep.15 The Parisian Macao Celebrates 10th Anniversary with Exclusive Moët & Chandon Dinners and Stunning Drone Shows
articles.summary: (Macao, Sept. 15, 2026) - To mark the milestone occasion of a decade of French-inspired hospitality, The Parisian ® Macao hosted an elegant, three-night Moët & Chandon dinner event over the past weekend. The dazzling celebration of this iconic Cotai Strip landmark was enjoyed by a distinguished gathering of government officials, VIPs and prominent media representatives.

articles.title: 2026 MSO Sands China Cup – Inclusive Community Basketball Carnival
articles.rawDate: Sep.13 2026 MSO Sands China Cup – Inclusive Community Basketball Carnival
articles.summary: (Macao, Sept. 13, 2026) – To promote social inclusion, support community sports in Macao, and actively respond to the Macao SAR government’s initiative to promote the integrated development of “sports + tourism,” Sands China held the 2026 MSO Sands China Cup – Inclusive Community Basketball Carnival Sept. 13 at the University of Saint Joseph, attracting over 250 residents from the local community. Representatives from several special education schools, community centres, and residential care homes, as well as members of four secondary school basketball teams, were invited.
